question: How do I add custom content to Ask Fern?
ground_truth: You can add custom content to Ask Fern by using the Documents API. This allows you to extend Ask Fern's knowledge beyond core documentation to include materials like internal FAQs, help desk tickets, knowledge base articles, marketing sites, and research papers. The uploaded documents will be indexed and made available as context when Ask Fern responds to user questions, with URLs included as citations when the content is referenced.
